summary: Mobile-overflow regression test across 11 pages at 360x800 and 390x844, plus desktop 1440 regression. Fixes on /services/weddings sections (Storytelling, ServiceBlock, WhyBlock, Testimonials, Mumbai/Goa, FAQ) are working — after animations settle none of those sections appear in the overflow report. HOWEVER the shared Footer (components/site/Chrome.jsx L473) still uses non-responsive `grid grid-cols-12 gap-10` and overflows on every mobile page tested. Its parent has overflow-hidden so scrollWidth stays == viewport width (no horizontal scrollbar), but footer content (Contact column, long address lines) is CROPPED at the right edge on all mobile viewports. Desktop layouts unaffected.

ui_bugs.issue: Footer main grid still declares `grid grid-cols-12 gap-10` with no responsive stacking. At mobile widths 360/390 the 12-column track + 40px gaps forces children (col-span-12 md:col-span-4, col-span-6 md:col-span-2) to render at 440px / 200px inside a 342px container. Because <footer> has overflow-hidden, scrollWidth stays equal to innerWidth (no horizontal scroll), but the Contact column, long address, and 4th-column content are visibly clipped at the right edge on every page.

issues: `snap-start shrink-0 w-[260px]` cards extend past viewport — this is an intentional horizontal-scroll carousel, verified working; no fix needed but noting because it shows up in overflow probes.

action_items: Convert Chrome.jsx footer grid (L473) to the same pattern used for the other fixes, e.g. `flex flex-col gap-8 md:grid md:grid-cols-12 md:gap-10` (or lg:grid) so that on mobile the four footer columns stack full-width and no content is clipped. This single change fixes footer clipping across all 11 tested pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Chrome.jsx L473 was the ONLY grid-cols-12 container missed in this iteration's sweep — it lives in the shared footer and therefore affects every page, which is why the mobile-overflow probe reports the same footer offenders (col-span-12 md:col-span-4, col-span-6 md:col-span-2, address blocks, Support/Contact headings) on all 11 tested routes.
Overflow-hidden on the footer masks the horizontal scroll but does NOT stop content clipping — the audit criterion `getBoundingClientRect().right > innerWidth+1` correctly still flags these as bugs.
Suggest a future guardrail: a lint or e2e assertion that no `grid-cols-12` class appears without an `md:` or `lg:` responsive prefix inside components rendered on mobile.

Motion `initial={{ x: -40/40 }}` on ServiceBlock/WhyBlock causes transient overflow during entry animation. Not a real bug (scrollWidth stays == vw and animation settles), but if you want cleaner probes, gate initial x-offset behind `md:` or use `clip-path` on parents.

success_rate.frontend: ~91% (10/11 pages fully clean after animations settle; footer clipping affects all 11 but does not cause horizontal scroll)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Probe results at 390x844 after animations settle: scrollWidth==innerWidth on every tested page (weddings, family-kids, product-ecommerce, events, editorial-portfolio, drone-services, portraits-headshots, live-streaming, boudoir-shoots, booking, client). Remaining `getBoundingClientRect().right > innerWidth` offenders on every page are: (a) shared footer children from Chrome.jsx L473 grid-cols-12 (real clipping bug), (b) intentional snap-scroll carousels on weddings 'Add-ons' and live-streaming 'What we cover', (c) decorative absolute-positioned blobs (`-top-40 left-1/2 w-[900px]`, `-right-24 w-[400px]`) which are inside overflow-hidden parents. The wedding page's Storytelling/ServiceBlock/WhyBlock/Testimonials/Mumbai/FAQ sections previously fixed no longer appear as offenders. Desktop 1440 regression: all pages scrollWidth==vw, layouts intact.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause identical to the one main agent already fixed in per-page files: `grid grid-cols-12 gap-N` on a ~342px mobile container forces the 11 gaps (11 × 40px = 440px) to exceed the container, making every child render wider than the viewport. Fix (already used everywhere else): replace with `flex flex-col gap-8 md:grid md:grid-cols-12 md:gap-10` (or lg:). The single missed instance is components/site/Chrome.jsx L473 (shared footer), which is why the bug reproduces on every route.
